repos_data.description: MCP server for US import duty research — HTS codes, Chapter 99 duties (Section 301 / IEEPA), MPF/HMF fees, and landed-cost math from official USITC data.
US Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) as CSV/JSON, chapter 99 additional duties by country (Section 301, 232, 338), and EU import duties by origin. Updated each HTS revision.
